title: Albumin–leukocyte interaction and elevated CRP: exploratory transport across two NHANES surveys
abstract: Adding a source-centered albumin × WBC term changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.174406 to 0.174320 (delta -0.000085; approximate joint source/target PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000292,+0.000136]). Incremental improvement was not established. A flexible additive conventional-measure model was trained on NHANES III and transported without target tuning to separately recruited 2017–2018 adults. This tests one statistical representation, not a new biomarker or causal mechanism. Previously explored public surveys are not untouched confirmation.
